content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 IxDF - Interaction Design Foundation: Course Director: UX, UI, and AI Anywhere in the World Texas UI/UX Design, Writing, Design, and Interaction Design Design Full-Time <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0168/2732/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Denmark <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://ixdf.org/about/careers">https://ixdf.org/about/careers</a> </p> <p>You've been designing long enough to have watched tools become essential and then disappear. You know which design skills are timeless and which ones expire.&nbsp;<strong>The human-centered design skills are where your heart is</strong>, and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon.</p> <p>You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.</p> <p>You can name the&nbsp;<strong>ten leading designers</strong>&nbsp;who should be teaching the world’s best courses and Master Classes right now. You know what each of them does better than anyone else, and where their gaps are.</p> <p>Now you get the opportunity to decide what hundreds of thousands of designers learn next.</p> <p>The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes include&nbsp;<strong>Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman</strong>, as well as Design Leads at&nbsp;<strong>Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe</strong>. Don Norman also chairs our executive board.</p> <p>You'll be involved in the entire process of creating our courses and Master Classes, and you'll lead many of the decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you to&nbsp;<strong>take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow</strong>. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. You’ll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.</p> <h2>Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education</h2> <p>IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us <strong>take online education to new heights</strong>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<strong>make a meaningful impact on humankind</strong>.</p> <p>At IxDF, we’re not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.</p> <p>We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.</p> <p>With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.</p> <h2>We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team</h2> <p>We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI</strong>: lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.&nbsp;<strong>This is the role described here.</strong></p> </li> <li> <p><strong><a href="https://ixdf.org/about/careers/education-designer-ux-ui-and-ai">Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI</a></strong>: lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong><a href="https://ixdf.org/about/careers/course-writer-and-editor-ux-ui-and-ai">Our Course Writers and Editors</a></strong>: lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the user’s perspective.</p> </li> </ul> <p>We're a flexible team, and you'll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.</p> <p><strong>You, the Course Director</strong>, decide what belongs in our curriculum and who should teach it. You reach out to the world’s leading experts, plan the courses with them, and shoot courses with them. When an Education Designer brings you a course outline, you're the one who says what's missing, what doesn't belong, and how to optimize the learning outcome so designers can succeed today. You'll work closely with our&nbsp;<strong>Co-Founder</strong>, your&nbsp;<strong>Team Lead</strong>, our other&nbsp;<strong>Course Directors</strong>, and the&nbsp;<strong>Education Designers</strong>, and you'll plan and create courses alongside them. Our Course Writers and Editors take the finished material the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.</p> <h2>Your Role at IxDF</h2> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Be a core part of our Editorial Team</strong>. You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.</p> </li> <li> <p>You'll research what already exists in a topic area, so that what we build is genuinely unique. You'll look at&nbsp;<strong>where design and AI are heading, what designers need&nbsp;</strong>that nobody has taught well yet, and&nbsp;<strong>what we should retire&nbsp;</strong>because the field has already moved on.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Find the people who should teach it.</strong>&nbsp;You decide a topic is worth a course, you work out who should teach it and why, you write the email, and you get the yes. Then you plan the content with the industry leader and agree what the course must leave a learner able to do.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Decide what each expert should teach.</strong>&nbsp;The best designers know a great deal, and a course that tries to capture all of it becomes an information dump.
